routes.summary: I-75 N → I-40 W Cookeville → I-24 / I-70 Topeka → I-70 Wheat Ridge → I-25 / I-80 Sunday → 900 Bitner Road, Apartment E17, Park City, UT 84098
routes.winterNotes: Sunday uses I-25 and I-80 over Sherman Summit, which stays lower than Eisenhower and Vail. Those Colorado passes are the backup only when Wyoming has snow and they are bare. If both have snow, stay in Wheat Ridge. The pin is Apartment E17, not the town centroid.
